tools.name: slack_thread
tools.description: A Slack thread, oldest first, with names and mentions resolved. Pass the message link the person shared, from any message in the thread.

channel.description: Without a link: the channel id.

ts.description: Without a link: the thread's ts.

workspace.description: Team id. Default: the link's workspace, else the default one.

tools.name: slack_search
tools.description: Search Slack messages, newest first, with Slack's syntax: words, from:@name, in:#channel, after:2026-10-01. Each match has its permalink.

workspace.description: Team id. Default: the default workspace.

tools.name: slack_post
tools.description: Post as the person: a reply in the thread of a message link, or a message in a channel. Plain text with Slack markup. Say only what they asked for.

channel.description: Without a link: the channel id to post in.

threadTs.description: With channel: the thread to reply in.

workspace.description: Team id. Default: the link's workspace, else the default one.

tools.name: slack_user
tools.description: Who someone is in Slack: by user id, email or name. Gives their name, handle, title, email and time zone.

who.description: A user id like U01AB, an email, or a name.

workspace.description: Team id. Default: the default workspace.
